Jack Goldburg left a successful corporate career to turn his love of food into a social phenomenon. He joins Alisyn Camerota to talk about taking a leap of faith, building Jack's Dining Room and finding success by choosing celebration over criticism.
Digit Murphy built women's hockey from the bench and the boardroom - coaching, fighting and lobbying long before the lights came on.
